name: Life expectancy at birth
definition: Period life expectancy at birth for New York City residents, in years, from NYC death certificates and population estimates.

latest_extra.note: Provisional figure stated by the NYC Health Department on its HealthyNYC page; the final figure will appear in the 2024 Summary of Vital Statistics.

source.name: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene, Summary of Vital Statistics (2020-2023 editions), Table M25

method: Life expectancy at age 0 read from Table M25 ('Life Expectancy at Specified Ages, Overall and by Sex') of the 2023, 2022, 2021 and 2020 Summary of Vital Statistics. Each edition covers ten years; for each year the newest edition's value is used, and overlapping years were checked for agreement. Race/ethnicity figures for 2023 come from the 2023 report's text (Hispanic/Latino, non-Hispanic white and Black) and its note on Asian and Pacific Islander New Yorkers; sex figures from Table M25.
caveats: The Health Department revised life expectancy for 2011-2019 when it adopted updated citywide population estimates (the Cornell Jeb E. Brooks School of Public Policy county estimates). Editions from 2019 and earlier printed lower figures for those years. This series uses only the revised basis, taken from the 2020-2023 editions, so it starts in 2011; 2010 on the revised basis is not published.
2023 is the latest final year. The 2024 Summary of Vital Statistics had not been posted when this was fetched; nyc.gov returned 404 for 2024sum.pdf.
No borough-level annual life expectancy is published in the summary (it gives community districts for 2014-2023 pooled), so there is no borough breakdown.
Peers: no source publishes city-level life expectancy for the other 24 cities on the same basis (annual, city boundaries, same population estimates), so peers are left out.
